title: Stereotactic radiotherapy of localized prostate cancer with daily online adaptive radiotherapy planning: a single-arm prospective interventional observational study (PCa SBRT Study)
summary: The aim is to set up a prospective study register in which all patients with localised prostate carcinoma who receive stereotactic radiotherapy on a linear accelerator with daily, AI-supported adaptive planning are included. Information about the disease, the therapy and its tolerability, the course of the disease and also technical parameters will be recorded. Blood samples will also be taken in order to collect samples and analyse possible additional biomarkers.

interventions.name:
A registry is to be created of patients with locally confined (< cT3 and cN0) prostate cancer or oligometastasis who are to undergo curative-intent radiation therapy using stereotactic radiation.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Informed consent available for the planned study and, if applicable, biobank
- Karnofsky performance score ≥ 60 
- confirmed localized (< cT3 and cN0) prostate carcinoma or oligometastasis
- curative-intended radiotherapy with suitability for SBRT
- IPSS (at time of inclusion in the study) < 13
- PACE-B criteria all fulfilled:
-- cT1 or cT2 primary
-- Gleason score max. 3+4
-- PSA < 20 ng/mL at the start of therapy
Exclusion criteria:
- polymetastasis
- previous irradiation in the pelvic area
- known HIV or hepatitis infection (for biobank)
- incapacity to give informed consent
